channel.title: Elastic incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Elastic's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Elevated Error Rates for Specific Models Impacting Elastic Inference Service in EU Regions [resolved]
item.description: From 21:50 to 23:42 UTC, we encountered elevated error rates for Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5, OpenAI GPT-5.6, and Google Gemini 2.5 Flash with the Elastic Inference Service in EU regions. This issue has now been resolved.

item.title: Issue impacting services running in GCP us-central1 [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved.

item.title: Replication bug causing slow recoveries [monitoring]
item.description:
Elasticsearch 9.5.3 has been released and all customers currently running 9.5.0, 9.5.1 or 9.5.2 are advised to update to this new version as soon as possible.
Impacted customers are advised to follow the workaround steps from https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/158212 after the upgrade.

item.title: [RESOLVED - 2026-08-26] APM endpoints for serverless projects not available [resolved]
item.description: This is now resolved

item.title: Elevated Error Rates Affecting Managed OTLP [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. The root cause has been identified and addressed. Customer workloads were not impacted during this incident.

item.title: Issue when creating Serverless projects in Azure eastus region [resolved]
item.description: Azure's storage component issues in the eastus region have been resolved. Consequently, Serverless project creation times have returned to normal and are functioning as expected.

item.title: Elasticsearch 9.5.1: false-positive matches in certain boolean queries [resolved]
item.description: Elasticsearch 9.5.2 has been released and contains the fix for this issue. Customers running 9.5.0 or 9.5.1 should upgrade to 9.5.2. At this time we are considering this issue resolved and will be providing no further updates.

item.title: Increased error rates for microsoft-multilingual-e5-large [resolved]
item.description:
The microsoft-multilingual-e5-large model has been retired from the Elastic Inference Service. Requests to this model now return an error.
Customers who wish to use this model with Elastic cloud must create a custom inference endpoint using their own API key. See our inference documentation for further details: https://www.elastic.co/docs/api/doc/elasticsearch/group/endpoint-inference

item.title: Serverless project creation delayed or failing [resolved]
item.description: We've resolved the issue affecting Serverless project creation and modifications. All systems are now operating normally.

item.title: GCP asia-south1 high latency [resolved]
item.description: On 2026-08-06 between 0900 - 1200 UTC, customers in GCP asia-south1 may have experienced high latency when communicating with their Elasticsearch deployments during this window. The cause has been identified and mitigated.

item.title: Elasticsearch 9.5.0 contains a query-correctness defect [resolved]
item.description: Elasticsearch 9.5.1 has been released and contains the fix for this issue. Customers running 9.5.0 should upgrade to 9.5.1. At this time we are considering this issue resolved and will be providing no further updates.

item.title: Metering issue with Elastic Cloud Hosted Deployments [resolved]
item.description: All metering errors have been corrected. We will be issuing refunds to the small number of affected customers.

item.title: AutoOps monitoring data not ingested for subset of deployments [resolved]
item.description: This incident was resolved on Jul 20 14:00 UTC, and was posted retroactively.

item.title: Elastic Cloud - Email MFA Delivery Delays (Gmail) [resolved]
item.description: Delivery delays have been resolved, MFA email delivery is fully functional for all customers.

item.title: AutoOps monitoring data not ingested for subset of deployments [resolved]
item.description: Resolved – This incident is resolved. Between Jul 18 02:40 UTC and Jul 20 14:00 UTC, a subset of Elastic Agents were unable to report metrics to AutoOps across all regions. The underlying issue has been corrected and data is flowing normally. Impacted deployments may notice some gaps in their AutoOps monitoring data during this timeframe.

item.title: Cloud Console Deployment Errors [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved

item.title: Elastic Cloud authentication issues using Microsoft login credentials [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Regional outage - Elastic Inference Service (EIS) [resolved]
item.description: The incident impacting a subset of customers with EIS in EMEA regions has been resolved. Services have been fully restored and the team has confirmed stability.

item.title: Partial outage - Elastic Inference Service (EIS) [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting EIS for Elastic Cloud customers with projects or deployments on GCP and Azure in EMEA regions has been resolved.

item.title: Internal Monitoring Data Delay [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved.

item.title: Issues delivering static assets to products [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved.

item.title: Issues with creating/updating Deployments in several regions [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved.

item.title: Ingestion issues for Managed OTLP and Managed Intake Service endpoints in the Azure Australia East region [resolved]
item.description: This issue is resolved.

item.title: Issue with Kibana authentication flow [resolved]
item.description: We have identified the root cause and mitigated the issue. Users should now be able to log in to Kibana via the "Log in with Elastic Cloud" button.

item.title: Intermittent Elastic Cloud Serverless Availability Issues in AWS us-east-1 [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved.

item.title: Customers may see delays with creating Azure serverless projects [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Missing Metrics in Cloud Console - Azure North Europe [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Issue creating new projects in AWS ap-southeast-2 [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved.

item.title: Upstream Azure Outage Causing Service Degradation [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Missing Metrics in Cloud Console - Azure Southeast Asia [resolved]
item.description: Some users experienced missing metrics visualizations in the Cloud console due to a disruption in metric data ingestion affecting deployments in the Azure Southeast Asia region. We have already stabilized the situation.
